function: Multi-agent PPO allocates the LEO satellite transmit power to NOMA users in each beam to minimize average age of information under QoS and power limits (pp. 1, 3).
system: Downlink LEO satellite, phased-array antennas forming M beams (p. 1); 2 beams, 4 UEs each, NOMA with imperfect SIC, Ka-band 20 GHz, no RIS (p. 4).
method: Multi-agent PPO with generalized advantage estimation (GAP3A); fully connected actor and critic networks; reinforcement learning, centralized training and decentralized execution (pp. 1, 4).
data_channel: Custom simulator: free-space path loss, Rician fading and Doppler shift following [3] (p. 2); satellite power and altitude taken from 3GPP TR 38.811 (p. 4); no dataset.
test_conditions: Main scenario of 2 beams and 4 UEs per beam (p. 4); sweeps of power budget, UEs and beams (p. 5); training for each sweep not stated.
baselines: Learned: DQN power control of [5] and standard PPO. Non-learned: greedy and WMMSE (p. 4).
metrics: Average age of information versus time, power budget, and numbers of UEs and beams; per-UE AoI for fairness (p. 5).
complexity: Order of complexity given as O of sums of neuron-count products between adjacent layers, for training and for execution; no runtime or FLOPs (p. 4).
q1_support: p. 2: "According to [3], the channel gain between the satellite and the UE n in beam m"; p. 4: "According to the official documents of 3GPP TR 38.811 [10], the LEO satellite has a typical transmission power of 50 dBm"
q2_support: p. 5: "To validate the generalization performance of the proposed algorithm, we tested it under different parameter sets."
q3_support: p. 4: "DQN: [5] proposed a DQN-based power control scheme to maximize system rate"; p. 5: "The average AoI of the ISTN realized by greedy and WMMSE algorithms is older"; p. 5: "the average AoI achieved by DQN and PPO algorithms are 37.5% and 10% older than GAP3A"

q5_support: p. 4: "The specific values of the remaining adopted system parameters and DRL hyperparameters are summarized in Table I"
notes: Included, area 6: the learned multi-agent PPO controls the transmit power of a LEO satellite downlink, which is physical layer in satellite links even though the reported metric is the age of information. q1 is 0: the channel is a custom free-space path loss plus Rician fading plus Doppler model taken from [3] (p. 2, Eqs. 1 and 2), and 3GPP TR 38.811 is cited only for the satellite transmit power, the orbital altitude, and the Doppler consideration (pp. 2, 4), not as the channel model; the reviewer may confirm this borderline case. q2 is 0 and borderline: the paper says it tested generalization under other power budgets, numbers of UEs and beams (p. 5, Figs. 4 and 5) but never says whether the policy trained on the main scenario is reused or retrained for each case, so a sweep without a stated training condition is not counted. q3 is 1: DQN of [5] is an earlier learned power control scheme, greedy and WMMSE are non-learned, all compared on the average AoI; the PPO baseline is the proposed method without GAE and is not counted. q4 is 1: orders of complexity for training and for execution are given on p. 4. q5 is 0: no code or data link and no public dataset.
